plan.notes: Source: official University of Iowa 2026-27 General Catalog, program page 'Computer Science, BS' (Bachelor of Science with a major in computer science, College of Liberal Arts and Sciences), transcribed by hand on 2026-09-30 from the catalog's 'Sample Plan of Study' table in the official CourseLeaf PDF (generated 2026-09-14): https://catalog.registrar.uiowa.edu/liberal-arts-sciences/computer-science/computer-science-bs/computer-science-bs.pdf . Catalog year 2026-2027 verified against the catalog homepage ('The University of Iowa 2026-27 General Catalog', covering fall 2026 through summer 2027). Note the catalog flags this as the FIRST version of the 2026-27 edition ('please check back regularly for changes; the final edition and the historical PDF will be published during the fall semester'). Credit ranges: catalog slots listed as 3-4 or 4-5 s.h. are recorded at the low end, so the plan sums to 125 - exactly the catalog's own stated low-end 'Total Hours 125-133'. The degree itself requires a minimum of 120 s.h. Quirk transcribed verbatim: the official sample plan lists the RHET:1030/ENGL:1200 rhetoric choice in BOTH Fall and Spring of Year 1 (confirmed against a second independent fetch of the same catalog PDF). Two 'Any Semester'/milestone items are administrative, not courses, and are omitted from the slot list: GE CLAS Core: Sustainability (0 s.h.; footnote a requires it to double-count with another GE area) and the Spring Year 4 'Degree Application: apply on MyUI before deadline' milestone (footnote j). Prerequisites: the sample plan publishes no per-course prerequisite table; prereq arrays encode only the plan's explicit footnote f (CS:2820, CS:3330, CS:3820 after CS:1210+CS:2210+CS:2230; program requirements add a C-minus minimum in prerequisite courses). Placement exams (footnotes b, c) are noted in choice_note fields, not as prereqs. Catalog honesty notes: (1) footnote i (advanced electives) says CS 3620-5890 excl. CS:3910/CS:3980/CS:4310 while the requirements section says CS 3420-5899 - footnote i is quoted verbatim in the choice notes; (2) the sample plan shows CS:2630 only, though the requirements allow ECE:3350 as an alternative; (3) the sample plan shows MATH:1850 only, though the requirements allow MATH:1550. Per the catalog, sample plans 'represent one way to complete a program of study; actual course selection and sequence will vary and should be discussed with an academic advisor,' and the Four-Year Graduation Plan is not available to BS computer science students.

courses.title: Natural science sequence course 1 (student choice from approved sequences)
courses.choice_note: Catalog: two or more courses in a sequence totaling at least 6 s.h. in a cognate natural science area (3-4 s.h. each; recorded at low end). Approved sequences: ASTR:1771+ASTR:1772 (Astronomy); BIOL:1411+BIOL:1412 (Biology); CHEM:1110+CHEM:1120 (Chemistry); SEES:1030 or SEES:1050 with SEES:1080 / SEES:1020 / SEES:2050 options (Earth, Environment, and Sustainability); PHYS:1611+PHYS:1612 or PHYS:1701+PHYS:1702 (Physics). The director of undergraduate studies may approve others. May double-count with the GE CLAS Core Natural Sciences requirement.
